name: Sentinel Corp Trigger-Discipline Training Gloves
description:
Smart-fabric gloves that monitor grip pressure, finger positioning, and hand tension in real time, providing haptic feedback when the wearer's grip pattern deviates from trained protocols. Originally designed for firearms training — the gloves vibrate when trigger discipline breaks down under stress.

Adopted by security firms for ongoing proficiency monitoring and by physical therapists rehabilitating patients with hand-trauma or augmentation integration issues. The data logs are admissible in some jurisdictions as evidence of proper weapons handling.
functionality: Grip monitoring, haptic correction feedback, training data logging
what_it_says: You take weapons handling seriously enough to let your gloves correct you when you slip.
story_hooks: A security officer's Trigger-Discipline logs show perfect form during a shooting incident — except for one 0.3-second window where the gloves recorded no hand at all, as though the trigger was pulled by something else.

physical_description.visual_profile: Form-fitting tactical gloves with a sleek, professional appearance. The hands look sharper and more controlled when worn, with subtle technological integration visible along the knuckles and palm. Gives an impression of precision and readiness.
physical_description.fit: Compression fit with articulated finger sections that conform closely to the hand without restricting movement. Wrist cuff extends 3-4 inches up the forearm with adjustable closure for varied arm sizes.
physical_description.primary_material: Smart-responsive synthetic leather with embedded conductive threading and pressure-sensitive microfiber panels on palm and finger surfaces.
physical_description.texture: Smooth synthetic leather exterior with subtle raised grid patterns on the grip zones. Interior features soft microfiber lining with tactile feedback nodes that are barely perceptible to touch.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal black with gunmetal gray accents along seams and wrist cuff. Subtle phosphorescent fiber tracery visible only under UV or low light, running along the metacarpal ridge.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap wrist closure with friction-fit Velcro adjustment strip for variable tension. No visible fasteners.
distinctive_features: Embedded pressure sensors in all fingertips and palm center
Haptic feedback nodes (subtle vibration points) distributed across knuckles
Data-transmission textile in wrist cuff — barely visible tech interface
Reinforced synthetic leather on trigger finger and index finger
Sentinel Corp minimalist logo stamped in matte finish on back of hand
Micro-perforations on sides of fingers for breathability during extended wear
Integrated temperature-regulation threads (invisible but functionally apparent)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 professional-grade equipment. High cost, restricted distribution. Signals corpo security, licensed trainer, or institutional employee.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by firearms trainers, corporate security personnel, tactical professionals, and rehabilitation specialists. Signals authority, discipline, and institutional trust. In some circles, these gloves mark someone as 'monitored' — compliance-oriented.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn. Signs of use appear as minor scuff marks on knuckles and a slight darkening of grip zones from repeated pressure mapping. Well-maintained due to their high cost and data-logging importance.
